rationale: First trainer in 20+ claude iters to crack W3+W4+W5 simultaneously (the bear-regime 0/20 wall) — 4/7 on default HP with +21.6% avg_ann. Fails are trade-count (W2 17 trades at WR 70.6%, W7 14 trades at WR 64.3%) suggesting threshold/pos-weight tuning can convert 2-3 more windows. The adversarial-validation HP axes (adv_alpha, adv_test_frac, adv_max_depth, weight_clip) are unswept from this angle — historical xgb_adv_val sweep peaked at 5/7 (#610) before the recent feature/data improvements (24-feature curated set, foreign-flow regime stats). Train mode should sweep adv_alpha in [0.3, 1.5] and adv_test_frac in [0.3, 0.4].
